description: 100% Deterministic Ford & Lincoln FORScan Companion (2011–2026+): Multi-Vehicle Garage (pre-seeded with 2023 F-150 Lightning ER Lariat 1FT6W1EV4PWG11434), 183 Community Recipes across 6 Platforms + 21 Curated Spreadsheet/PDF Downloads + Custom Spreadsheet Line Builder, Hybrid VIN Barcode/Photo/OCR Scanner with ISO 3779 Modulo-11 Auto-Repair, .abt & Motorcraft .ab XML Importer/Differ, 87-Module Guide, and In-Cab Session Planner.
tagline: Blue Oval Garage v2.0 — 2011–2026+ Ford & Lincoln Multi-Vehicle FORScan Companion, VIN Barcode/OCR Scanner & Deterministic As-Built Engine

quickstart.step: Select or Add Any 2011–2026+ Ford/Lincoln (`🔵 Garage & VIN`)
quickstart.detail: Your 2023 F-150 Lightning ER Lariat (`1FT6W1EV4PWG11434`, ⚡ BEV) is pre-seeded as Vehicle #1. Tap `+ Add Vehicle` to add any 2011–2026+ Ford or Lincoln by typing a 17-char VIN or scanning the door-jamb B-pillar sticker / windshield VIN plate with the Hybrid Camera Barcode + OCR Scanner.

quickstart.step: Load a Baseline (`.abt` / `.ab` or `🧪 Demo Baseline`)
quickstart.detail: Tap `📂 Import .abt / .ab File` to load your real FORScan `.abt` module backups or Ford Motorcraft `.ab` XML—or tap `🧪 Load Demo Baseline` to preview live nibble mask and checksum dry-runs immediately for the active vehicle.

quickstart.step: Browse 183 Recipes, 21 Master Spreadsheets & Custom Lines (`🎛️ Mod Menu`)
quickstart.detail: Browse 183 verified recipes across 6 upstream platforms (`f150`, `super_duty`, `bronco`, `explorer`, `ranger_6g`, `mustang`), download 1-click `.xlsx`/`.pdf` community master spreadsheets (Livnitup, ZooDad, DanMc85) for all 21 platforms, or use `➕ Quick-Add Custom Spreadsheet Line` to enter any forum/spreadsheet hex mod with deterministic checksum dry-run.

quickstart.step: Run Your In-Cab FORScan Session (`📋 Session Plan`)
quickstart.detail: Open the `📋 Plan` tab in the vehicle cab with your OBDLink EX (`STP31` HS-CAN + automatic `STP33` 125 kbaud MS-CAN guidance for 2011–2020 CGEA 1.2/1.3 vehicles). Verify every target module has a saved `.abt` backup and copy/share your exact line-by-line write sheet.

navigation_map.purpose: Multi-vehicle garage switcher, Hybrid Camera Barcode/OCR VIN scanner with ISO 3779 Modulo-11 auto-repair, offline + NHTSA vPIC decoder, and JSON Vault export/import.
3-Layer FORScan catalog: 183 platform-filtered recipes, 21 curated community master spreadsheets (.xlsx/.pdf), and Quick-Add Custom Spreadsheet Line builder.
Complete Ford/Lincoln control module directory (`726`, `7D0`, `720`, `740/741`, `7E7`, `746`, etc.) with CGEA 1.2/1.3 MS-CAN (`STP33`) notes, write-risk ratings, and per-vehicle backup evidence.
Per-vehicle module backup coverage checker, `.abt`/`.ab` importer, Factory vs. Current byte drift differ, Motorcraft AsBuilt helper, and Checksum Calculator.
Printable/shareable in-cab FORScan write sheet with CGEA 1.2/1.3 vs. FNV2 adapter guidance, required module backups, and exact target hex lines.

deep_dive_features.title: Hybrid VIN Barcode + Optical Confusable Auto-Repair (`Code -> Vision -> Code`)
deep_dive_features.body: Combines native `BarcodeDetector` (Code 39 / DataMatrix door-jamb stickers with automatic 18th-char `'I'` guard stripping), Canvas CLAHE contrast enhancement, and a deterministic ISO 3779 Position 9 Modulo-11 repair engine that tests single- and double-character optical confusable substitutions (`O/Q/D -> 0`, `I/L -> 1`, `Z -> 2`, `S -> 5`, `G -> 6`, `B -> 8`) until the mathematical check digit passes.

deep_dive_features.title: Full 3-Layer Vehicle-Specific FORScan Catalog & Custom Mod Builder
deep_dive_features.body: Layer 1 ships 183 structured recipes across F-150/Lightning, Super Duty, Bronco, Explorer/Aviator, Ranger 6G, and Mustang with dynamic powertrain gating (`ICE_ONLY` blocked on `BEV`, unlocked on `ICE_GAS`/`ICE_DIESEL`/`HEV`). Layer 2 provides 1-click `.xlsx`/`.pdf` community spreadsheets for 21 Ford/Lincoln platforms (2011–2026+). Layer 3 lets you add any custom spreadsheet line (`726-12-01`, `xxxx-**xx-xxxx`) with full nibble-mask and Modulo-256 checksum dry-runs.

deep_dive_features.title: 100% Deterministic Nibble Mask, Checksum & Multi-Vehicle Isolation
deep_dive_features.body: Evaluates `set`, `bits`, and `offset` nibble operations across multi-step recipes and recomputes exact Ford line checksums (`sum(header + data[:-1]) & 0xFF`). Every vehicle in your garage maintains isolated `.abt`/`.ab` backups, starred mods, custom lines, and session verification history.

pro_tips: When scanning a door-jamb barcode on Ford trucks, the deterministic normalizer automatically strips the leading `'I'` Code 39 guard character from 18-character barcode payloads.
For 2011–2020 CGEA 1.2/1.3 vehicles, modules `740 DDM`, `741 PDM`, `733 HVAC`, and `791 TRM` reside on the 125 kbaud MS-CAN bus—use an electronic bus-switching cable like OBDLink EX (`STP33`).
